# Lieyuan Yang



I am an Assistant Professor of Economics at School of Economics, Renmin University of China. I received my PhD in Economics from the University of Minnesota in 2026.

My research fields are **macroeconomics**, **public economics**, and **economic growth**. My work combines rigorous empirical analysis with structural models to study the macroeconomic effects of public policy, with a particular focus on fiscal redistribution, local public investment, regional growth, and economic measurement.

## Research Fields

- Macroeconomics
- Public Finance
- Economic Growth
